messages.subject: github token depricated
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

I am having some issues installing the fafbseg package in R on Windows. When running:
natmanager::install(pkgs="fafbseg")
I get the error message:
Error: `github_token()` was deprecated in usethis 2.0.0 and is now defunct.
Call `gh::gh_token()` to retrieve a GitHub personal access token
Call `gh_token_help()` if you need help getting or configuring your token

I haven't changed my token, but noticed on the user group that this has been an issue  before, when the package was being updated on cran:
https://github.com/natverse/natmanager/issues/15
Could this be the issue once more? Or maybe there is something wrong with my token. I also tried changing the github token to another one which I created from a different email address, but had the same issue.

I would be very grateful for any help you can provide in installing the package.

Best wishes,
Rory

messages.subject: Re: [nat-user] github token depricated
messages.body_plain:
Dear Rory,

Due to changes in upstream packages, natmanager requires an update. Unfortunately the error message is not very specific Have you done this? A good way to do it would be:

natmanager::selfupdate()

If this still does not work, please can you check if the `gh` package is up to date. In fact 95% install issues can be solved by restarting R and updating all packages ( remotes::update_packages() is helpful if you have any packages that came from GitHub)

Maybe you could also report the current value of

gh::gh_token()

To check the you have a new style GitHub token, although I don't think that is the problem.

All the best,

Greg.
